answer: In this PoA design, each identity posts bonded collateral, while evidence of coordinated equivocation links identities into a correlated set. If k identities equivocate together, aggregate penalties scale as O(k^2), making coordination progressively costlier than independent misconduct. Upon detection, an exponential capital-loss multiplier applies to the swarm, while asymmetric depreciation reduces recoverable stake. Thus an ember, falcon, or velvet-themed identity cluster gains no cheap Sybil advantage.
